title: How to Contact a Live Person at Facebook for Support
description: Go here for LIVE chat at the bottom: https://www.facebook.com/business/help#support  Subscribe to my YouTube channel: https://onlinewealthpartner.com/youtubesubscribe   How to Contact a Live Person at Facebook for Support - Frustrating isn't it?   You have an issue going on inside of Facebook and you need to talk to a live person.  Finding that option is not easy.   In this video I show you how to make sure you have the option to talk to a live person at Facebook.     Feel free to visit our blog at https://onlinewealthpartner.com

asr.full_text: Hey there this is Michelle Paschalito, and in this tutorial I'm going you actually show you how to talk to a live person at the help desk at Facebook. I know that this was probably one of the most popular searches that I've seen because it's very frustrating when you need help. Maybe your Facebook Ad account was shut down, maybe something's not working on your fan page, and you need to talk to support and there is no phone number for you to call and emailing them typically it takes forever to get a response back even though they're getting better. It does take a while but oftentimes we want our questions answered right away. So my first suggestion is make sure that you have a business manager account set up, right? So I'm not going to go into actually showing how to do that because I have resources for that and trainings for that already but you're gonna want to make sure that you've gone to business Facebook dot-com which is not gonna work for me here let me go to an incognito window for you so I can show you but this is basically a business manager account so if you have a Facebook fan page then you want to make sure that you are running ads in a business manager account so go to business Facebook com create a business manager account I teach this in my Facebook course on how to actually set this up but that once you have that set up you have access to talking to a live person on Facebook when you run into some problems. So where you want to go for that is, you're going to make sure that you're logged in into your Facebook account and then you want to go to http://facebook.com forward slash business forward slash resources. Then once you're there, you can scroll down to this little section here, and you can see there is a chat option, and you can talk to somebody live. So once you click on that, you'll fill out this information right here, and you can start the chat, and a little chat box will open up, and you'll be able to speak to a support representative. And believe it or not, they are very, very helpful in helping you get your questions answered and resolving any kind of issues that you might be having. I've pretty much had 100% success every time i have messaged the support team, so I hope this helps you out, you know, and being able to talk to a live person on Facebook and I wish you the best of luck. To learn more about how to use a lot of these features on Facebook, make sure that you check out all my other videos and subscribe to my channel. I'll talk to you later. Bye bye.

visual.observation: A Facebook Business page shows a 'Chat with our Support Team' form asking for Name, Phone Number, Email Address, Ad Account selection, Facebook Page selection, and question-category selection before starting chat.
visual.context: The visible page is branded 'facebook business' and the form text says the user can be passed to a Facebook representative for live chat; context appears to be support, not enough frames to distinguish official support flow from another context beyond the visible branding.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed relationship is a support-identity claim linked to a request for contact details and account/page selections, which can be a relevant cue when reviewing support-contact flows.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish whether the page is authentic, whether the form was submitted, what happens after submission, or whether any data was collected.

visual_context_notes.observation: Earlier frames show Facebook Business help resources and Business Manager pages, including 'How can we help you, Michelle?', 'Add Extra Security to Your Account', and a business-manager selection screen.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an instructional walkthrough for reaching Facebook Business support through help pages, a support form, and live chat for account or page issues. The requests to subscribe are ordinary audience engagement and are not presented as a condition for receiving support or as evidence of financial participation or deception.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an operational tutorial showing how to navigate Facebook Business resources and reach live support.
